In this study, the Parametric Energy-Environment Planning System (PEEP) is used to forecast the development of the electricity supply and demand structure in the main urban area of Nanjing, taking into account the terminal demand for energy and the supply and demand structure of energy species. The development trend of social electricity consumption in the future decades and its key influencing factors are evaluated, which provide reference for the electricity planning in the main urban area of Nanjing and also the whole Jiangsu Province. In the "Progressive Development Path" (PDP) scenario, the end-use electricity consumption ratio in Nanjing's main urban area will reach about 42% in 2030, and social electricity consumption will increase by 32% compared to 2020; the end-use electricity consumption ratio will reach about 55% in 2060.

articleTitle: Study on Collaborative Planning and Allocation Method of Integrated Energy System Considering Dynamic Characteristics of Multiple Loads in Southwest Border Area
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Smart Grids and Energy Systems (SGES)
abstract: The comprehensive promotion of the "Belt and Road" initiative and the "dual-carbon" strategy provides opportunities for the economic development of the Southwest border, but also puts forward high-quality development requirements. The rapid development of urbanization in the Southwest border region has caused a surge in the demand for building energy, as well as the dynamic characteristics of "season-geography". Therefore, it is of great significance to carry out collaborative planning and allocation methods of fixed resources and flexible resources to promote the efficient collaborative operation of the integrated energy system. This paper presents an integrated collaborative planning optimization method for fixed resource and flexible resource planning-operation of an integrated energy system taking into account the dynamic characteristics of multiple loads in the southwest border region. Aiming at the comprehensive optimization of economy, environmental protection, reliability and flexibility, and considering the characteristics of equipment and the dynamic characteristics of multiple loads of buildings, a planning optimization method combining fast non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm III with elite strategy and dynamic data envelopment analysis and Rank and ratio synthesis ranking method is adopted to realize the rational planning and allocation scheme of fixed resources and flexible resources in an integrated energy system. The results show that the proposed planning and operation integrated cooperative planning and allocation method can effectively improve the comprehensive performance of the integrated energy system, and has important practical significance for the cooperative planning and allocation of fixed and flexible resources in the southwest border area.

articleTitle: A Rapid Risk Assessment Method for AC-DC Distribution Networks with Source-Load Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Smart Grids and Energy Systems (SGES)
abstract: Traditional AC distribution networks have limited regulation and control methods and insufficient operational flexibility and are prone to the problems of over-voltage when a high proportion of renewable energy is connected. AC-DC hybrid distribution network (HDN) can realize flexible power transfer in space and time through converters and energy storage devices to achieve complementary interconnection between networks, thus making full use of the resource endowment in different regions, improving the efficiency of power utilization. Traditional risk assessment methods mainly focus on AC distribution networks. However, the abundant quantity and intricate nature of uncertain factors in high dimensional networks, coupled with their variable operational modes, render risk evaluation increasingly challenging. In this paper, our proposal entails a rapid risk assessment approach for HDNs encountering source-load uncertainty, with the objective of expediting risk evaluation and offering operational and dispatch guidance. A Gaussian mixture model is employed to depict the source-load uncertainty and conduct probabilistic power flow analysis. By integrating the risk-utility function, the operational risk of the system can be appraised. Ultimately, a case study is conducted to substantiate the efficacy of our proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Texture Direction Detection for Side of Stacking Solar Cells
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Smart Grids and Energy Systems (SGES)
abstract: The stripe texture features for the side of stacking solar cells are rich, and the texture direction detection is an important research content of image segmentation and quantitative calculation for stacking solar cells. However, the complex background and noise interference bring difficulties to the high-precision and efficient texture direction detection. Therefore, based on the texture direction consistency for the side of stacking solar cells, the existing direction detection algorithms based on slicing and gradient are improved in this paper. In addition, according to the gray distribution, Hough transform, Radon transform, and spectrum analysis for stacking solar cell images, four direction detection methods of image texture for the side of stacking solar cells are proposed. The four proposed methods based on gray distribution, Hough transform, Radon transform, spectrum analysis, and the two improved methods based on slicing and gradient analysis are used to extract the texture direction of stacking solar cells. The comparison experiment results show that, compared with the two improved methods, the average errors of texture direction detection for the side of stacking solar cells by the four proposed methods is reduced by 1.49°, 1.47°, 1.51°, 1.55°, and 1.34°, 1.32°, 1.36°, 1.4° respectively. The proposed methods have great advantages in accuracy, speed, complexity, and noise resistance performance. It lays a foundation for accurate and fast image segmentation of stacking solar cells based on image texture direction.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation of an AA-CAES Based Energy Hub in Electricity and Heating Markets
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Smart Grids and Energy Systems (SGES)
abstract: Coupling of electricity and heating systems is conducive to efficiency improvement and peak-to-valley demand adjustment. AA-CAES (Advanced adiabatic compressed air energy storage) with the capability of cogeneration can integrate power and heating systems. This paper establishes a bi-level operation model for an AA-CAES based energy hub interacts with electricity and heating systems, where the heating system is modeled considering flexible demands. Finally, a multi-parametric programming based method is proposed to reformulate and solve the bi-level model. Case studies show that the proposed model can provide optimal bidding and operation strategies of electricity and heat for the AA-CAES based energy hub.

Author Keywords: advanced adiabatic compressed air energy storage (AA-CAES)

articleTitle: Multi-type energy hierarchical partition regulation strategy of multi-time scale
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Smart Grids and Energy Systems (SGES)
abstract: Achieving a significant increase in renewable energy consumption relies heavily on the optimal control of an integrated energy system comprising diverse energy units. This approach holds paramount importance in the pursuit of sustainable energy utilization. This paper proposes a multi-type energy hierarchical partition regulation strategy of multi-time scale. To accomplish this, the strategy builds classification models that rely on distinct operating states from a range of energy generation units, energy consumption units, and energy storage units. These models play a crucial role in effectively optimizing the integrated energy system and facilitating the transition towards renewable energy utilization. The primary objective of this strategy is twofold: to minimize the operating costs of the system and simultaneously achieve the target of increased renewable energy consumption. By adopting this approach, we can efficiently manage resources and promote sustainable energy practices. It takes into account the response time and response capacity constraints of each energy unit and performs hierarchical and partitioned control at multiple time scales. Simulation results demonstrate that the multi-type energy hierarchical partition regulation strategy of multi-time scale effectively promotes renewable energy integration and reduces the operating cost of the integrated energy system.

articleTitle: Active Operation Strategy of Hybrid Energy Storage in Regional Integrated Energy Systems Based on Long Short-Term Memory Network
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Smart Grids and Energy Systems (SGES)
abstract: The inherent heat and power coupling characteristics of cogeneration units in a regional integrated energy system (RIES) limit their flexibility and operational efficiency. However, the charging and discharging capabilities of energy storage systems depend on their energy states. Conventional "electricity-dictated heating" and "heating-dictated electricity" strategies fail to comprehensively consider the fluctuating characteristics of multi-load demand and renewable energy in the long term, making it difficult to fully leverage the flexibility of energy storage systems. This paper adopts long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network deep learning methods to prospectively predict the long-term trends of load and renewable energy changes. An optimization dispatch model is established considering factors such as carbon emission penalties, renewable energy curtailment penalties and other costs. A strategy is proposed to coordinate heat storage and power storage. Taking a specific RIES as an example, it compares with the traditional "electricity-dictated heating" and "heating-dictated electricity" strategies. The results show that the maximum prediction error of the LSTM neural network is 4.7%. Compared to the other two strategies, the hybrid storage active operation strategy can reduce operating costs by 11.12% and 3.67%, respectively. Additionally, it can smooth the heat-electricity load curve and thus reduce the RIES electricity procurement cost, improve cogeneration efficiency, and further reduce total operating costs.

articleTitle: Charge and Discharge Control Methods of Photovoltaic Micro-grid Battery Under Local Shadow Condition
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Smart Grids and Energy Systems (SGES)
abstract: Due to the change of illumination conditions, the steady-state imbalance of charge and discharge of photovoltaic micro-grid battery will be caused. Therefore, the study on the control method of charge and discharge of photovoltaic micro-grid battery under the condition of the local shadow is proposed. The composition of piconets PV cell characteristics and charge and discharge characteristics are analyzed, connected by a three-wire connection, through such a long line to eliminate lead line resistance measurement error caused by illumination conditions, and the modified method is used to estimate the battery SOC. According to the data acquisition of sunlight intensity change, diminishing design current charging method and maintenance of busbar voltage discharge method are adopted. The simulation results show that the design method can keep the steady state of the battery under the condition of a 10%, 20%, and 30% shadow ratio, and has obvious advantages compared with the contrast method.

articleTitle: Bidirectional Matching Model of Virtual Power Plant and Distributed Resources Considering Multiple Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Conference on Smart Grids and Energy Systems (SGES)
abstract: With the large-scale emergence of distributed energy resources (DERs), the difficulty of grid dispatching has increased dramatically. The aggregation of DERs can continuously expand the scale of virtual power plants (VPPs), reduce the complexity of grid scheduling, and promote the further development of VPPs. First, the multiple uncertainty of wind power, PV, and load within VPP is handled using multi-scenario techniques, and based on calculating uncertainty-based VPP revenue models. Second, the expectation factor-based DER selection VPP model and the cooperative propensity-degree based VPP selection DER model are proposed, respectively. Then, the Gale-Shapley algorithm is used to implement the two-way matching model between VPP and DER. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model is verified by arithmetic examples.
